text: To study MBBS, BDS and BSN Programs in China are becoming popular for international students all over the world. The programs are designed to work closely together with highly competent students and develop their intellectual and technical knowledge in medicine one step at a time. Beyond knowledge and skill in medicine, the program also trains the students how to read the medical literature, how to conduct medical research and publish or market their knowledge. It trains the students the importance of self-motivated learning as a lifelong exercise. As part of the curriculum we are in the process of negotiation to offer an international clinical rotation program and our education and examination systems ensure that doctors graduating from SWMU will have a distinct advantage in their very competitive career development path. Duration & Academic year & Educational system of SWMU : 5 to 5.5 years including 1 to 1.5 years compulsory internship. The internship can be finished in Chinese hospitals or in hospitals of your own country. The program will be conducted on six months semester basis. Therefore the total academic semesters will be 10 to 11 including internship. SWMU provides International teachers especially from South Asian countries such as Pakistan,India,Bangladesh and Nepal with MBBS and BDS programs so as to provide high quality education, advanced teaching equipments, co-operative administration and innovative teaching methodology. SWMU is recognized by WHO, UNESCO, CSC, CMC, and teaches the whole course with USMLE/PLAB based exam and preparation. The university will provide provisional certificate after the completion of 4 and 1/2 years course for students who want to do their internship in third country.
